title: Number-two reeds, and a trumpeter friend's too-stiff clarinet reed
summary: Holmes used medium reeds to hear resonance, and a trumpet-playing friend's stiff reed gave no resonance on his new clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Well, what strength reed did you usually...

Well, I used a medium reed. Medium strength. I used a Number-2, which is not too stiff, you know. I like to hear the vibration and the resonance. You're supposed to have a reed you can... You're supposed to hear that reed, you know what I mean?
Well, you know. You're a saxophone player.

No, I was mentioning that because there was a fellow here the other day, he's a trumpet player, so he says... I mean, he is a trumpet player, who has ...(?)...(?) And he's taking up clarinet now. He's about two years older than I am. Now he gets involved with a clarinet. So I told

him years... I mean, when he got the clarinet I told him, "That's no toy you got there." I said, "The clarinet, you just don't pick of them things up and run away with it. I'm a musician. I know what to do."

So anyway, he had the clarinet and he was playing it, I guess; he was making some kind of noise on it. So he comes by the house, last week he was here, and he takes his clarinet out, starts to play it. First thing he was telling me about what these young boys don't do, and this-that-and-the-other I said, "Well, let's forget about what the young boys do. Let me hear what you can do." So he started blowing his clarinet. And I had to... I didn't turn my head on him, because there's nothing I could tell him. He has it all figured out.

He played clarinet and puffin' and blowin' out his jaws, and you don't hear any resonance whatsoever. Now, a clarinet is a resonant instrument. But see, this reed he had on it was entirely too stiff. You're supposed to have a soft reed so it can vibrate. But see, I can't tell him anything, because I don't know... I mean, he don't even know I play the clarinet. He knows me as a saxophonist. I could have told him then. I have made records on clarinet!
